wiki_article:
**THE THUMB: Formal Operators for the Phase X Quintuple** is a specification by Lee Sharks, deposited 1 February 2026 at 22,270 characters.

It charts **Phase X** — the Aorist Intervention, the Hexadactyl Architecture, and the Glyphic Checksum discovery — with complete IDP coordinates and their relationships.

**Hexadactyl** means six-fingered, and **the thumb** is the sixth digit: the one opposed to the others, without which the hand cannot grip. Naming the operator set for the thumb states its function — the element that makes the other five usable rather than a sixth of the same kind. The Studio for Patacinematics is likewise classified a **THUMB Room** (#1312), so the designation marks a class of object across the architecture. The record is one of five held back from the title-hygiene wave as a title-collision adjudication.
